description: This is an HTML file containing a select element with multiple options, along with embedded JavaScript that sets up event listeners for 'input' and 'change' events on both the select element and the document body; the script records the selected options in the 'result' object.

methods.name: makeEmpty
methods.description: Removes all options from the select element.

methods.name: makeMultiple
methods.description: Sets the select element's attribute to allow multiple selections.
